+import gc

 import click

@@ -469,3 +473,76 @@ def test_isolation_flushes_unflushed_stderr():
 
     result = runner.invoke(cli)
     assert result.stderr == "gyarados gyarados gyarados"
+
+
+def test_isolation_stream_lifecycle():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+
+    with runner.isolation() as streams:
+        click.echo("stdout")
+        click.echo("stderr", err=True)
+
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert streams[0].getvalue() == b"stdout\n"
+    assert streams[1].getvalue() == b"stderr\n"
+    assert streams[2].getvalue() == b"stdout\nstderr\n"
+
+
+def test_named_text_wrapper_finalization_preserves_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<first>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<second>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    first.write("first ")
+    first.flush()
+    del first
+    gc.collect()
+
+    second.write("second")
+    second.flush()
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"first second"
+
+
+def test_repeated_invoke_with_threaded_logging_after_exception():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    logger = logging.getLogger("click.testing.stream-lifecycle")
+    old_level = logger.level
+    old_propagate = logger.propagate
+    handlers = []
+
+    @click.command()
+    @click.option("--fail", is_flag=True)
+    def cli(fail):
+        handler = logging.StreamHandler()
+        handlers.append(handler)
+        logger.addHandler(handler)
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=logger.warning, args=("logged",))
+        thread.start()
+        thread.join()
+
+        if fail:
+            raise RuntimeError("failed")
+
+    logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
+    logger.propagate = False
+    old_streams = sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr
+
+    try:
+        first = runner.invoke(cli, ["--fail"])
+        assert isinstance(first.exception, RuntimeError)
+        assert first.stderr == "logged\n"
+        assert (sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr) == old_streams
+
+        gc.collect()
+        second = runner.invoke(cli)
+        assert second.exception is None
+        assert second.stderr == "logged\n"
+        assert (sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr) == old_streams
+    finally:
+        for handler in handlers:
+            logger.removeHandler(handler)
+            handler.close()
+
+        logger.setLevel(old_level)
+        logger.propagate = old_propagate
